description: A CV and gate breakout for TwinSlide, placed immediately to the right of it: the inputs replace the sequencer track by track, and the outputs carry what the sequencer is playing.

inputs.text: Replaces that track's pitch while a cable is in it, at 1V per octave.
Replaces that track's gate while a cable is in it; above 1V the track sounds.
Above 1V, that track glides into the note it is playing instead of stepping to it.
Detunes that track's voice, ±5V for the full ±700 cents, added to that voice's FINE knob.
Shifts the pitch of both voices by the voltage here, at 1V per octave, without touching the CV the sequencer puts out.

outputs.text: The pitch the sequencer is playing on that track, at 1V per octave, including its slide and microtuning.
A 10V gate while that track's step is sounding.
10V while that track is gliding between two notes, 0V otherwise.
10V while the step that track is on is marked with an accent.

notes: This module does nothing on its own: without TwinSlide immediately to its left, every output reads 0V and the inputs go nowhere.
The outputs always carry the internal sequencer, even for a track whose input is being overridden, so a track can be driven from outside and read out at the same time.
The mark above the input section fades from white to amber once TwinSlide is found to the left.
